people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: They came to Jerusalem with stringed instruments, harps, and trumpets to Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: So they entered Jerusalem and went into the house of the LORD with harps, lyres, and trumpets.
translations.kjv: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD.
translations.asv: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of Jehovah.
